title: Physical-Work Fluctuation Relations from Accessible Quantum Macrostates
summary: Jarzynski's equality recovers an equilibrium free-energy difference from nonequilibrium work trajectories, but its exponential average can converge very slowly because rare trajectories carry large weight. We show that coarse thermodynamic information measured at the nonequilibrium endpoint can reduce this sampling burden while keeping the same microscopic trajectories and the same free-energy target.
